## Summary
Update the daemon's GitHub integration to generate pull requests with meaningful titles and descriptions instead of only showing the project ID.

## Requirements
- Generate descriptive PR titles that summarize the changes made
- Include PR body with:
  - What changes were made
  - Why the changes were made (based on project context/PRD)
  - Reference to the project that generated the PR
- Maintain existing daemon PR creation workflow

## Implementation Constraints
- Code is in `src/daemon/github.rs` and `src/daemon/mod.rs`
- Must work with existing project state structure (`.ralph/projects/<id>/state.json`)
- Should utilize available project metadata (PRD, loop artifacts, etc.)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] PR titles are descriptive and concise (max 80 chars)
- [ ] PR bodies include summary of changes made
- [ ] PR bodies include rationale/context from project
- [ ] Project ID is still referenced (in body or metadata)
- [ ] Changes work with existing daemon workflow
- [ ] No regression in daemon PR creation functionality
